verdict.rationale: Marqeta provides a well-documented sandbox environment isolated from production, explicitly stating cards created there cannot conduct real-world transactions since it doesn't communicate with card networks, and offers simulation endpoints for card transactions, plus a quick-start tutorial for testing full workflows in sandbox. This applies equally to AI-native usage via the MCP server, which lets agents interact with the same sandbox-testable API. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party confirmation of sandbox fidelity or AI-agent-specific sandbox testing walkthrough.
